rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for someone who seems mentally crazy or whose behavior has gone out of control.

example.english: You’re crazy—you’d actually dare jump down despite it being so dangerous!
example.traditional: 你真係癡線，咁危險都敢跳落去！
example.jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 ci1 sin3 gam3 ngai4 him2 dou1 gam2 tiu3 lok6 heoi3

rows.note: Pick 癲 for a stronger sense of wildness, extremity, or loss of control, including wildly surprising situations.

example.english: This price is crazy; no one would believe it.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gaa3 cin2 din1 dou3 mou5 jan4 seon3

rows.note: Use 興奮 when “crazy” means extremely excited or enthusiastic rather than mentally unsound.

example.english: We’re all crazy excited about going on a trip tomorrow.
example.traditional: 聽日去旅行，我哋個個都好興奮。
example.jyutping: ting1 jat6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 ngo5 dei6 go3 go3 dou1 hou2 hing1 fan5

rows.note: Use 好鍾意 for “crazy about” when the context makes clear that the strong liking is romantic.

example.english: They’re crazy about you and think about you all the time.
example.traditional: 佢真係好鍾意你，成日都掛住你。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 zung1 ji3 nei5 seng4 jat6 dou1 gwaa3 zyu6 nei5
